Your holdings:

Watch:

Bottom line:
Focus on aggressive risk management for your deeply underwater, leveraged positions.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far above the current price of 48.73. Consider adjusting or exiting this -78.32% leveraged position.
